subject: Deal desk approval: multi-year rate-fence & renewal safety net (StrataScale)
messages:
From: Kristen Hayes <kristen.hayes@stratascale.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft SOW + ask on pricing cadence

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team's excited about the latency and cost profile on the Redwood Dedicated offering. We're working through procurement and legal; attached is a draft SOW and a high-level forecast for the next 36 months.

Two specific asks from our procurement lead:
- Can Redwood lock list pricing for the first 24 months of a 36-month term?
- If price increases post-lock are necessary, can you commit to an uplift cap (they suggested no more than +8% year-over-year)?

Current footprint: 24 reserved GPUs with burst for spikes. We're targeting a 36-month committed deal in exchange for a deeper discount up front. Budgeting needs mean they want predictability in years 1–2.

Attachment: StrataScale_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF, 245 KB)

Can you and Ben confirm what flexibility you have here? We may need an exec exception for a multi-year price commitment.

Best,
Kristen
Procurement Lead, StrataScale
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Draft SOW + ask on pricing cadence

Lauren — forwarding StrataScale's procurement note. Quick summary:
- 36-month commitment; want price lock for first 24 months.
- Post-lock, asking for uplift cap ~8% y/y (they proposed).
- They will commit to 24 reserved GPUs and predictable burst pattern.

Our standard multi-year guidance allows price locks up to 24 months but uplift caps beyond standard policy require executive approval if discount > 25% or if we accept tighter uplift caps. They are also asking for a deeper up-front discount in exchange for the commitment.

Proposed commercial carve:
- 36-month term, 28% list discount on base rates applied year 1–2; price locked for 24 months.
- Uplift cap of +10% for year 3 (absolute cap, not compounding).
- Renewal protection clause: if they renew within 90 days of expiry, offer a one-time matching window to limit increases to +6% from their renewal quote.

We need exec approval for the uplift cap +10% and the 28% discount (this exceeds my self-serve threshold). Ben — can you attach the pricing workbook that maps to these numbers?

Thanks,
Olga
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft SOW + ask on pricing cadence

Olga,

Approve with conditions. I reviewed the forecast and the attached pricing sheet Ben shared. Approve an executive exception to allow:
- Up to 30% off list on committed capacity (apply as blended discount across reserved units).
- Price lock for first 24 months.
- Uplift cap of +12% absolute for year 3 (we'll cap liability); however, require the clause that the uplift cap cannot be combined with any future promotional credits or retroactive discounts.
- Renewal protection: include a single renewal matching window (90 days) where we will limit increases to +6% if customer signs within that window.

Conditions: include an explicit SLA credit cap in the SOW and require Finance to sign off on revenue recognition treatment for the 36-month deferral. Legal to review the renewal protection language to avoid evergreen pricing exposure.

Ben/Sean — please prepare: revised pricing sheet, an amended SOW with the approved language, and a draft DocuSign envelope. I expect this to be finalized by Monday so procurement can work the signature cycle.

-Lauren
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Kristen Hayes <kristen.hayes@stratascale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + ask on pricing cadence

Kristen — quick update. Internal approvals are in place pending final SOW language. Approved commercial framework:
- 36-month term with a 24-month price lock.
- Blended 28–30% discount on committed capacity (finalized in attached pricing workbook).
- Uplift cap for year 3: absolute +12% (non-compounding).
- Renewal protection: one 90-day matching window post-expiry with a +6% max increase if exercised.

Per Lauren's note, Legal will tighten the renewal protection wording and Finance will confirm revenue treatment. We're attaching a revised SOW and pricing workbook for procurement review. Please confirm if this meets StrataScale's predictable-budget requirement and we will route the DocuSign for signatures.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sheet_q4_2026.xlsx (XLSX, 120 KB); StrataScale_SOW_draft.pdf (updated)

Thanks,
Olga
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Kristen Hayes <kristen.hayes@stratascale.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 17:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + ask on pricing cadence

Olga, Ben — this is great news, thanks. The 24-month price lock and the uplift ceiling for year 3 are exactly what procurement was asking for. Legal will still run through your renewal protection language, but this should address our CFO's requirement for predictability.

Please send the DocuSign when ready and include a marked SOW so we can start internal routing.

Best,
Kristen
Procurement Lead, StrataScale
